name: L’Escape, a Luxury Collection Hotel
insider_take: Tucked in the heart of Seoul's Jongno district, L'Escape is a rare blend of French-inspired elegance and Korean sophistication — a true sanctuary where Parisian romance meets the energy of one of Asia's most dynamic cities.
whats_special: L'Escape channels the spirit of a classic French boutique hotel, with interiors curated by celebrated designer Jacques Garcia — the same visionary behind Paris's iconic Hôtel Costes. Every corner of the property tells a story through rich velvets, antique-inspired furnishings, and dramatic chandeliers, making it one of Seoul's most visually striking luxury stays. As part of Marriott's prestigious Luxury Collection, it also sits within the STARS program, offering elite travel perks for discerning guests.
pro_tip: Book a room on an upper floor for sweeping views of Seoul's skyline and the surrounding mountains — the city looks absolutely magical at dusk from this vantage point.
dont_miss: Don't overlook La Brasserie , the hotel's stunning all-day dining venue serving French-Korean fusion fare. Steps away, you'll find the Gyeongbokgung Palace and the charming lanes of Bukchon Hanok Village — a perfect contrast to the hotel's European grandeur. For beauty lovers, the legendary Myeongdong shopping district is just a short ride away.
pros: Prime location in the heart of Seoul's vibrant Myeongdong district, steps from premier shopping, dining, and cultural landmarks
Elegantly designed rooms and suites blending European boutique charm with sophisticated Korean aesthetics
World-class dining experiences featuring acclaimed on-site restaurants with curated local and international cuisine
Exclusive Marriott STARS Program benefits including complimentary upgrades, daily breakfast, and personalized amenities
Exceptional concierge service delivering bespoke cultural experiences and seamless access to Seoul's top attractions
cons: Bustling urban setting may not appeal to travelers seeking a quiet or secluded retreat
Premium luxury positioning places it at a higher price point compared to other Seoul accommodations
